subject: Hearthstone Bank RFP: evidence delivery & timeline for abuse-monitoring controls
messages:
From: Rajiv Mehta <rajiv@hearthstonebank.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: product-security@hearthstonebank.com
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Hearthstone RFP — follow-up on abuse-monitoring evidence

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the RFP packet; our security and procurement teams are reviewing. We have two quick asks before we move to the evidence collection step:

1) Can you provide a concise mapping (1-pager) that ties your misuse monitoring capabilities to the specific RFP sections: detection telemetry, alerting SLA, incident escalation, and retention? We need this for our audit team.

2) We require sample logs (redacted) that show how a flagged conversation is recorded in your system: what fields are captured, timestamps, user identifiers (hashed), and what metadata accompanies a detection. We won't need full PII.

Can you confirm a delivery timeline? We are targeting legal review by 2/25.

Regards,
Rajiv Mehta
Head of Product Security
Hearthstone Bank

Attachments: none
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Mehta <rajiv@hearthstonebank.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hearthstone RFP — follow-up on abuse-monitoring evidence

Hi Rajiv —

Thanks for the clear asks. We can deliver both items. Proposed plan:

- 1-pager mapping document: delivery by 2026-02-17 EOD PST
- Redacted sample logs + schema appendix: delivery by 2026-02-18 EOD PST

I'll loop in Lauren (security ops) and Priyom (trust & safety) to prepare the artifacts and confirm redaction standards. If those dates work, we'll package the artifacts and provide a brief walkthrough on the 19th.

Are there any specific retention windows or log formats your audit team prefers (e.g., CSV vs. JSON)?

Thanks —

Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: none
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Rajiv Mehta <rajiv@hearthstonebank.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 15:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hearthstone RFP — follow-up on abuse-monitoring evidence

Hi all —

Attached are the draft artifacts:
- Redwood_AbuseMonitoring_Mapping_1pager.pdf (PDF) — ties product features to RFP sections
- Sample_Detection_Logs_redacted.json (JSON) — three example events (policy_violation, toxicity, misuse) with hashed IDs
- RFP_Response_Table.xlsx (XLSX) — cell-level answers for the RFP questions

Notes on redaction and fields captured:
- User identifiers are hashed with a salted HMAC (we've redacted salts in samples).
- Each detection event includes: event_id, detection_tag, model_version, confidence_score, timestamp_utc, session_hash, rule_id (if matched), action_taken (flagged/blocked), and alert_id for routing.
- Retention: default telemetry retention is 90 days for flagged content, with 365-day optional archival for enterprise customers under contract.

Attachments: 3 files (see filenames above)

Let us know if you need a specific CSV export format — we can provide that on request. We can also schedule a 30-min walkthrough on 2/19 to go through fields.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Security Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
From: Anika Rao <anika.rao@procure.hearthstonebank.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: Rajiv Mehta <rajiv@hearthstonebank.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hearthstone RFP — follow-up on abuse-monitoring evidence

Lauren/Markus —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the artifacts. A couple of follow-ups from procurement/security:

- Can you confirm the SLA for alerts reaching our SOC (time-to-notify) and whether you offer webhook delivery to our Splunk/Datadog ingestion? Provide the metric and a sample webhook payload.
- We also need a signed non-disclosure addendum and the SCIM provisioning MOU. Can you send a link to your standard DocuSign package so our legal can push it through? 

If you can provide the webhook payload example and DocuSign link by EOD 2/18 that would keep us on track for legal review by 2/25.

Best,
Anika Rao
Senior Procurement Manager
Hearthstone Bank

Attachments: none
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Anika Rao <anika.rao@procure.hearthstonebank.com>, Rajiv Mehta <rajiv@hearthstonebank.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hearthstone RFP — evidence delivery & next steps

Anika/Rajiv —

Deliverables attached and links below:
- Artifacts: Redwood_AbuseMonitoring_Mapping_1pager.pdf, Sample_Detection_Logs_redacted.json, RFP_Response_Table.xlsx
- Webhook example: sample_webhook_payload.txt (included in ZIP)
- DocuSign package (NDA + SCIM MOU): https://app.docusign.com/packaging/Redwood-Hearthstone-HSB-2026-007
- HubSpot opportunity: https://redwood.hubspot.com/opp/HSB-2026-007

SLA summary (excerpt):
- Alert routing: median notify latency 18 seconds (95th percentile 120 seconds) for streaming detections on Dedicated instances. Webhook retry policy: exponential backoff with 5 retries over 48 hours.
- We support webhook delivery and direct Splunk ingest via HEC token; sample payload included.

Next steps we propose:
1) Your legal signs DocuSign (link above).
2) Schedule 30-min technical walkthrough (proposed slots: 2026-02-19 09:00 or 14:00 PST).
3) Onboarding kick-off once contracts are executed — we will provision archival retention per the SOW.

I've attached a ZIP with the artifacts (filename: hearthstone_evidence_bundle_v1.zip) and included a short README.

Thanks — looking forward to the walkthrough.

Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
